Wedged between two boulders he found a green glass bottle, its cork sealed with candle wax. Inside was a single sheet, the ink blurred but readable. 'To whoever keeps the light: my brother sailed past your tower in 1987 and never reached harbour. I only want to know that someone was watching.' Tomas read it three times. He copied it out, sealed it in the bottle, and walked to the post office.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在空荡的街口亮着，把柏油路照出一片淡黄。环卫工人推着车慢慢走过，扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。便利店的玻璃门里，店员靠着货架打了个哈欠。远处的高架桥上偶尔驶过一辆货车，灯光一闪便消失在黑暗里。楼上的窗户大多暗着，只有几扇还亮着，像是有人彻夜未眠。空气又凉又清，带着一点潮湿的味道。东边的天际线还没有变亮，但面包店的烟囱已经冒出了第一缕热气，新的一天正悄悄开始。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a Russian nesting doll that has a smaller doll inside.\n- Each copy keeps handing a smaller piece to the next copy until the piece is so small that the answer is obvious, like the tiny doll that does not open.\n- Then the answers come back one by one, and together they solve the big job."}
